about.title: About Me
about.message: Hello, I'm Tran, an Information Systems graduate with hands-on experience in software development. I specialize in backend development using Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, MySQL, PostgreSQL, while also having experience building web applications with React and TypeScript. Through my internships and personal projects, I've gained practical experience in designing APIs, implementing business logic, working with databases, and developing full-stack applications. I'm passionate about solving technical challenges, writing clean and maintainable code, and continuously improving my engineering skills. I'm currently seeking a Software Engineer opportunity where I can contribute to real-world projects and grow as a professional engineer.

contact.title: Contact Me
contact.message: Thank you for taking the time to explore my portfolio. I'm currently seeking Software Engineer opportunities, with a focus on backend and full-stack development. I'd love to connect and discuss how I can contribute to your team.
